external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Established in 2010, Mondottica USA was formed by Harvey Ross and is based in Warren, NJ. Mondottica USA operates within a 27,000 square foot state-of the-art facility which includes all company operations, warehouse, and fulfilment center. Mondottica USA distributes fashion brands and its own collections throughout the Americas. Collections include Anna Sui, Joules, Karen Millen, Pepe Jeans, Ducati, United Colors of Benetton, Bloom Optics, Christian Lacroix, Hackett, Sandro, Gizmo Kids and Scot
